subject.title: Android: Enter key should send message when physical keyboard is connected

question: Should the remaining key-sequence fix be handled by a fresh follow-up from the assigned owner, or by repairing the older conflicting contributor PR?
rationale: The source-level fix shape is narrow, but there is both an active assignee with live repro evidence and an open conflicting PR that still references this issue.

options.title: Use a fresh focused follow-up
options.body: Close or supersede the older conflicting PR after a fresh fix covers repeat/key-up consumption, modified Enter, disabled send, and composing input with live Android proof.

options.title: Ask the open PR to repair
options.body: Require the existing contributor branch to rebase, address the current-source gaps, and add live Android proof before it can remain the implementation path.

recommendation.title: Use a fresh focused follow-up
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the older conflicting PR after a fresh fix covers repeat/key-up consumption, modified Enter, disabled send, and composing input with live Android proof.

likelyOwner.reason: joshavant is assigned and provided the current live E2E evidence for the remaining behavior.
